note.name: NEAR Protocol
note.thesis: NEAR trades at 75.5x annualised fees and 220.1x annualised revenue against a 25.5x peer median. Own-chain activity is collapsing, the buyback offsets about a tenth of issuance, and positioning is still long. The Intents business is real but richly priced.
note.what: NEAR is a layer-1 blockchain whose main product is NEAR Intents, a solver-based cross-chain swap service that settles on NEAR: a user states a goal, professional solvers bid within about a second, and settlement happens on NEAR. Chain Signatures let a NEAR account sign on Bitcoin, Ethereum or Solana without a bridge.

points.text: Thirty-day fees annualise at $74.18M against $54.24M for the trailing year; revenue annualises at $26.75M against $9.51M. Revenue is what the protocol keeps.

points.bold: The chain is not the product
points.text: Intents grossed $50.0M in fees in the year to September 2026 versus $1.27M on NEAR's own chain, on $4.8B of September volume.
Over the 30 days to 30 September 2026, own-chain transactions fell to 0.80M a day from 4.68M in 2025, active accounts fell 79% and new accounts 95%.

points.bold: Valuation sits far above the peer
points.text: FDV divided by annualised fees is 75.5x and by annualised revenue 220.1x, against 25.5x for deBridge and a 25.5x peer median.

points.bold: Revenue is inflecting and capture rising
points.text: Lifetime Intents fee capture is about 16.4% and 28.4% over the trailing 30 days, with $30.42B settled in the year to September 2026.

note.supplyHeadline: No unlocks due, but 2.5% inflation runs
note.supplyText: DefiLlama shows 1.305B of 1.305B tokens unlocked, no cliffs and no new tokens in the next 90 days, with circulating supply of 1.311B. Issuance is 2.5% a year, about 32M NEAR. A buyback of 1.85M NEAR offsets roughly 10% of the 19.2M issued since 23 Feb 2026. Staked supply is 592.01M, or 45.17%.
note.valuationText: For NEAR, revenue matters most: Intents generates the volume and NEAR keeps only part of the fees, about 28.4% over the trailing 30 days. FDV divided by annualised revenue is 220.1x; by annualised fees, 75.5x. The peer median is 25.5x.
note.usageText: In the year to September 2026 Intents grossed $50.0M in fees against $1.27M on NEAR's own chain, with $4.8B of volume in September alone. Own-chain transactions fell to 0.80M a day from 4.68M.

catalysts.text: No new tokens unlock; no cliffs in the window.

risks.title: Issuance cut passes
risks.text: Governance approving a cut from 2.5% to 1.6% would remove a central part of the bear argument.

risks.title: Buyback scales up
risks.text: If the buyback offsets materially more than a tenth of new issuance, supply pressure eases.

risks.title: Intents volume holds
risks.text: Sustained Intents volume near $177M a day would support the current revenue multiple.

risks.title: Own-chain usage stabilises
risks.text: A turn in transactions and active accounts would undercut the collapse argument.

watchlist.item: Governance proposal to cut issuance to 1.6%
HSP-027 removal of the 30% developer gas rebate reaching mainnet
DefiLlama unlocks page shows 95,829 NEAR/day core-team unlocks
CoinGecko 24h fees of $60,115 versus DefiLlama 30d annualised

note.positioningText: Funding is positive at +0.0100%/8h now and +0.0088%/8h on a 7-day average, so longs pay shorts. Open interest fell 23.9% in seven days to $181M across exchanges, and the long/short account ratio is 1.25, with 55% of accounts long.
note.conclusion: NEAR's Intents business is real and fees are accelerating, but the token prices that at 220.1x annualised revenue against a 25.5x peer median. Own-chain usage is collapsing, the buyback offsets about a tenth of issuance, and funding and the long/short ratio show the crowd is still long. The evidence points down inside the eight-week range.
note.invalidation: 7-day annualised fees fall below the 30-day pace for two consecutive weeks
note.gaps: No primary source on team, foundation or investor sales. No dated vote on the 1.6% issuance cut. DefiLlama's unlocks page conflicts with the bot read, and CoinGecko's 24h fees conflict with DefiLlama's 30-day annualised figure. No points-programme data found.
